opportunities.title: Kunming Biodiversity Fund (KBF) 2026 Call for Proposals - Stage 2
opportunities.funder: Kunming Biodiversity Fund (initiated and financed by the Government of China; Secretariat hosted with UNEP)
opportunities.program: Kunming Biodiversity Fund - 2026 Full Size Project call
opportunities.deadline_text: The deadline for Stage 1 submissions is 15 September 2026. ... A second deadline for Stage 2 submissions is 15 November 2026. ... All submissions must be made to the KBF Secretariat by 23:59 on the day of the respective deadline.
opportunities.funding_text: The project budget for each single country project is no more than $500,000. Regional projects with multiple countries will also be considered. The project budget for each multi-country project should not exceed $800,000.
opportunities.eligible_applicants: UN organizations (direct recipients) co-developing the project with an eligible developing-country Party to the CBD; non-UN organizations only as sub-partners.
opportunities.eligible_countries: Developing country Parties to the CBD (guidelines prepared 'to assist developing country Parties to the CBD'); Colombia is a CBD Party and developing country.
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: Alliance/CIAT cannot be the direct recipient. It can only join as a non-UN sub-partner of a participating UN organization (e.g., UNEP, UNDP, FAO country office) on a country-endorsed project (e.g., Colombia, with endorsement from the CBD national focal point / Ministerio de Ambiente).
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: A UN Participating Organization chosen by the beneficiary country; PSC no more than 7%; endorsement letter(s) from the CBD national focal point or designated official in the lead ministry (one per country for multi-country projects).
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Country-level or sub-national implementation of KMGBF/NBSAPs in developing country Parties.
opportunities.consortium_details: Must be co-developed between the country and a UN Participating Organization; non-UN organizations may be sub-partners.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Thematic areas: restoring and protecting ecosystems; mainstreaming biodiversity into policies/planning; strengthening resource mobilization; sharing benefits from genetic resources and DSI. Must respond to gaps in the Global Review of KMGBF implementation (incl. biodiversity data and monitoring systems).
opportunities.required_documents: Full project proposal template (Annex 2), budget template (Annex 3), compliance with KBF Risk Management Strategy (Annex 4), CBD focal point endorsement letter(s).
opportunities.application_procedure: Email the proposal to the KBF Secretariat at kbf@un.org; review by the KBF Independent Technical Advisory Group, final decision by the KBF Executive Council; results anticipated by 31 Dec 2026 for Stage 2.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Biodiversity/restoration focus; EO-based restoration and agrobiodiversity monitoring, landscape planning tools could be a component, but RS/AI is not the core ask.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: China-funded, UN-channelled biodiversity money for Colombia/LAC; fits Alliance Multifunctional Landscapes and Bioversity agrobiodiversity mandate.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Team capability is fine, but only ~1 month remains and the project needs a UN agency lead plus a ministerial endorsement letter, which is hard to get in time unless a UNEP/UNDP/FAO Colombia proposal is already in preparation.
opportunities.recommendation: Pursue only as a sub-partner: ask UNDP/FAO/UNEP Colombia offices and Alliance biodiversity colleagues immediately whether a Stage 2 proposal is being prepared and offer the EO/biodiversity monitoring component. Otherwise monitor for the 2027 call.
opportunities.potential_partners: UNEP LAC office, UNDP Colombia, FAO Colombia; Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible (CBD focal point); Instituto Humboldt; Alliance Bioversity agrobiodiversity teams.
opportunities.next_action: Before end Oct 2026: email kbf@un.org for the annexes/templates and contact UN country offices in Colombia to join a Stage 2 proposal as sub-partner.

evidence.deadline_quote: A second deadline for Stage 2 submissions is 15 November 2026. ... All submissions must be made to the KBF Secretariat by 23:59 on the day of the respective deadline.
evidence.eligibility_quote: For this Call for Proposals, the KBF will only directly fund UN agencies. Beneficiary countries will access funding through the participating UN organization. Non-UN Organizations may be considered sub-partners in all proposals, as appropriate.
evidence.status_quote: Start date 11 Aug 2026 End Date 15 Nov 2026 ... The 2026 Call for Proposals will be conducted in two stages

opportunities.title: NSFC-CGIAR Cooperation Program (within NSFC Sustainable Development International Cooperation Science Program, SDIC)
opportunities.funder: National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC), with CGIAR
opportunities.program: SDIC 2026 Calls for Proposals: Guideline One - vi) NSFC-CGIAR Cooperation Program
opportunities.deadline_text: 2026 round (closed): "The online application submission period is from March 31, 2026, to May 15, 2026, at 16:00 Beijing time." No 2027 round announced yet.
opportunities.funding_text: Up to 11 Key Projects and up to 10 Cooperative Exchange Projects ... For Key Projects, NSFC budget is up to 1.8 million RMB per project (direct costs) ... For Cooperative Exchange Projects, NSFC budget is up to 150,000 RMB per project. (NSFC funds the Chinese side.)
opportunities.duration: Key Projects 3 years (2027-2029); Cooperative Exchange Projects 2 years (2027-2028)
opportunities.eligible_applicants: Chinese PI at an NSFC-registered host institution (senior title; current/previous PI of an NSFC project of 3+ years). Overseas PI must be a researcher from a CGIAR center.
opportunities.eligible_countries: Chinese applicant in mainland China; overseas partner from any of the CGIAR research centers.
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: CIAT/Bioversity researcher can be the 'Oversea PI' (the 2026 text: 'The oversea principal investigator should be a researcher from one of the 13 CGIAR research centers'). The Chinese partner submits; NSFC funds only the Chinese side, CGIAR side contribution Not specified.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: "The Chinese applicants should hold a senior professional technical position (or equivalent title) and, as principal investigator, be currently undertaking or have previously undertaken a NSFC research project with a duration of three years or longer." Max 2 Chinese cooperating institutions; one international cooperative research project per applicant per year.
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Chinese lead in mainland China; research of relevance to China and other developing countries.
opportunities.consortium_details: Chinese PI + CGIAR overseas PI; joint English application signed by the overseas PI; collaborative agreement after approval; title format 'CGIAR+specific project title'; Bilateral Strategic Alignment Statement (Appendix 5).
opportunities.cofunding_details: NSFC budget covers the Chinese side only; CGIAR-side funding not described.
opportunities.eligible_activities: 2026 directions included (B) Biodiversity and Climate Change (climate-resilient cropping systems; monitoring and decision assessment of agricultural biodiversity and resilience; restoration and carbon sequestration) and (C) Digital Agriculture and Precision Management (decision support systems for agrifood systems and dryland agriculture), plus germplasm, water/drylands, AI nutrition, livestock, fisheries.
opportunities.required_documents: Chinese application in NSFC system; joint English application (Appendix 1) signed by overseas PI; Bilateral Strategic Alignment Statement (Appendix 5); collaborative agreement (Appendix 2) after approval.
opportunities.application_procedure: Chinese PI applies via https://grants.nsfc.gov.cn (Joint Research under Organizational Agreements > SDIC - Key Project). Application code 1 must be under C or G.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: 2026 directions explicitly cover climate-resilient cropping, agrobiodiversity monitoring/assessment and digital decision support systems; direct fit for RS/AI/crop modelling.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Dedicated CGIAR channel with China; Alliance named in earlier rounds; builds China-CGIAR partnerships.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Feasible if a Chinese PI with an NSFC 3-year grant is identified early; proposal mostly written in English by both teams.
opportunities.recommendation: Top-priority China channel but currently closed. The round timing moved from Aug-Sep (2025) to Mar-May (2026), so identify a Chinese co-PI (e.g., CAAS, China Agricultural University, AIRCAS) now and draft a concept to be ready for a likely early-2027 call.
opportunities.potential_partners: CAAS Institute of Agricultural Resources and Regional Planning; Aerospace Information Research Institute (AIRCAS); China Agricultural University; Nanjing Agricultural University; CGIAR China Office.
opportunities.next_action: Contact CGIAR China Office (ZHANG Xinxuan) and NSFC contact (WANG Lei, wanglei1@nsfc.gov.cn) to ask about the 2027 timeline; line up a Chinese PI by Jan 2027.

opportunities.funder: National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC)

opportunities.deadline_text: 2026 round (closed): "科学基金网络信息系统在线申报接收期为 2026 年 6 月 5 日至 2026 年 7 月 27 日 16:00 时" (online submission 5 June - 27 July 2026, 16:00).
opportunities.funding_text: 拟资助能力培育项目 23 项左右，资助强度不超过 60 万元/项（直接费用）；重点项目 15 项左右，资助强度不超过 200 万元/项 (about 23 capacity-building projects up to 600k RMB; about 15 key projects up to 2M RMB; youth exchange and seminar projects up to 300k RMB). Chinese side only.
opportunities.eligible_applicants: Chinese PI (senior title, NSFC 3-year project PI). Foreign partner: "外方合作者应在境外从事科学研究，具有所在国（或所在地）相当于副教授以上的专业技术职务（职称），并独立主持实验室或重要的研究项目" (foreign partner must work abroad, hold associate-professor-equivalent title, and independently lead a lab or major project).
opportunities.eligible_countries: Any country for foreign partner; focus on Belt and Road partner countries and typical regions worldwide.
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: Senior Alliance scientist could be the foreign collaborator of a Chinese PI. No CGIAR-specific window. Chinese lead required.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: 中方申请人应具有高级专业技术职务（职称），应作为负责人正在承担或承担过 3 年期（含）以上国家自然科学基金项目 (Chinese applicant must hold a senior title and be/have been PI of a 3+ year NSFC project).
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Chinese mainland lead; '重点聚焦“一带一路”共建国家及全球典型区域' (focus on Belt and Road countries and typical global regions).
opportunities.consortium_details: Chinese PI + foreign collaborator; joint English application signed by the foreign partner.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Direction (五) 气候变化下的农产品安全: '构建气候适配型粮食稳产预测与风险预警体系，研发推广跨境协同的气候智慧型农业方案' (climate-adapted grain yield prediction and risk early-warning systems; cross-border climate-smart agriculture). Integration of observation, simulation, big data and AI is encouraged.
opportunities.required_documents: Chinese application; English application (Appendix 1/2) signed by the foreign partner; cooperation agreement after approval.
opportunities.application_procedure: Chinese PI via https://grants.nsfc.gov.cn (组织间合作研究 > SDIC).
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Yield forecasting/early warning under climate change using observation, modelling, big data and AI is exactly the researcher's profile.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Builds China partnerships on climate-ag forecasting; Belt and Road framing fits less with LAC but global typical regions allowed.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Feasible as foreign collaborator, but the foreign partner must hold associate-professor-equivalent rank and lead a lab or major project, so a senior Alliance scientist may need to be the named partner.
opportunities.recommendation: Closed for 2026; watch for a 2027 Guideline Two. Pair with a Chinese crop-modelling/RS group.
opportunities.potential_partners: AIRCAS, CAAS-IARRP, China Agricultural University, Nanjing Agricultural University.
opportunities.next_action: Monitor NSFC guide list from ~March 2027; secure Chinese PI.

opportunities.title: SDGSAT-1 Open Science Program (free satellite data; quota increase by research proposal)
opportunities.funder: International Research Center of Big Data for Sustainable Development Goals (CBAS), Chinese Academy of Sciences
opportunities.deadline_text: No deadline; continuous registration and proposal submission on https://www.sdgsat.ac.cn/.
opportunities.funding_text: Data access in kind (no cash). Default quota of 20 images after registration; larger quotas via proposal.
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: Individual Alliance researchers register directly and submit a proposal to raise the quota.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: Registration on sdgsat.ac.cn; proposal with research information for higher quota.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Research use of SDGSAT-1 10 m multispectral (incl. two red-edge-adjacent bands), 10 m glimmer (night light) and 30 m thermal infrared data.
opportunities.application_procedure: Register at https://www.sdgsat.ac.cn/register; click 'proposal submission'; contact sdgsat1@cbas.ac.cn if quota is not updated.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: 30 m TIR is useful for crop water stress/ET and 10 m MS for crop mapping; complements Sentinel/Landsat in yield and phenology work.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Opens a door to CBAS/CAS collaboration (DBAR/DSP networks) and SDG2/13 reporting; data, not money.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Trivial to apply; data handling within team skills.
opportunities.recommendation: Register and submit a quota proposal for a Colombia/Honduras crop thermal-stress pilot; use it as a basis for a joint CBAS paper or NSFC/ANSO proposal.
opportunities.potential_partners: CBAS / AIRCAS (Guo Huadong team), DBAR / Digital Sustainability Programme (DSP) network.
opportunities.next_action: Register on sdgsat.ac.cn and submit a proposal; email sdgsat1@cbas.ac.cn.
